# AEITCH (AEITCH SMC PVT LTD)
> Enterprise AI Automation & Software Engineering Collective

AEITCH (legally incorporated as AEITCH SMC PVT LTD) is an enterprise software engineering collective and technology consultancy. We architect autonomous AI agent systems, full-cycle SaaS products, resilient multi-cloud infrastructure, and custom high-throughput distributed backends for organizations in the United States and globally.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [AI Automation & Autonomous Agents](https://www.aeitch.com/services/ai-automation): Stateful multi-agent swarms, private enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with pgvector, dynamic LLM orchestration with LangGraph, and deterministic output evaluation guardrails.
- [Product Development & MVP Engineering](https://www.aeitch.com/services/product-development): Rapid 4–8 week fixed-price MVP sprints, scalable SaaS platforms, type-safe full-stack architectures (React, Next.js, TypeScript), and accessible design systems.
- [DevOps Consulting & Multi-Region Cloud](https://www.aeitch.com/services/devops-cloud): Multi-region Kubernetes cluster federation (EKS, GKE), deterministic Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), zero-downtime CI/CD canary automation, and cloud cost optimization (FinOps).
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.aeitch.com/services/custom-software): Bespoke distributed event streaming systems, high-concurrency microservices in Go and Rust, and legacy modernization via the Strangler Fig pattern.

## Technical Insights & Research

- [Private RAG for Enterprises: Architecture and Data-Leakage Controls](https://www.aeitch.com/insights/private-rag-enterprise-architecture): VPC isolation, pgvector HNSW indexing, and document-level ACL projection.
- [Multi-Agent Workflows: LangGraph vs Custom Orchestrator](https://www.aeitch.com/insights/multi-agent-workflows-langgraph-vs-orchestrator): Cyclic execution graphs, state checkpoints, and latency trade-offs.
- [How to Scope an MVP in 4-8 Weeks Without Tech Debt](https://www.aeitch.com/insights/scope-mvp-four-eight-weeks-without-tech-debt): Scope discipline, end-to-end type safety, and staging milestones.
- [Kubernetes Cost Optimization: A Practical FinOps Checklist](https://www.aeitch.com/insights/kubernetes-cost-optimization-finops-checklist): Right-sizing CPU/memory, Karpenter dynamic node pools, and Spot orchestration.
- [Legacy Modernization: Strangler-Fig Migration](https://www.aeitch.com/insights/legacy-modernization-strangler-fig-migration): Zero-downtime API gateway routing and Change Data Capture (CDC) with Kafka.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): AI Search Citations](https://www.aeitch.com/insights/generative-engine-optimization-ai-search): Entity declaration, technical information gain, and LLM answer engine retrieval.
